title: [Cloud] End-to-End AI App Dev: Gemini Pro + RAG + Google Cloud (Live Demo)
description:
In this session, we’ll start by exploring the fundamentals of Generative AI, how these models work, where they shine, and why they’re transforming the way we build applications.

We’ll then dive into Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), a powerful approach for building intelligent Q&A systems using private or enterprise data.

The session includes a live demo where we’ll show you how to build and deploy a RAG-based AI application on Google Cloud using the AI Application service, which provides built-in capabilities for indexing and querying custom data sources.

By the end of this session, you’ll learn how to create your own enterprise-grade AI search app using Gemini Pro, RAG, and Google Cloud all without managing complex infrastructure.

Perfect for developers, cloud enthusiasts, and anyone looking to bring powerful AI features into their apps!
